# LAMMPS input script for SiO2 NPT quenching
# Quenching from 5000K to 1500K at 3.5 K/ps under NPT ensemble

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute temperature
compute myTemp all temp

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density pe ke etotal

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# NPT quenching from 5000K to 1500K
# Temperature change: 5000 - 1500 = 3500 K
# Rate: 3.5 K/ps
# Time needed: 3500 / 3.5 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps (with dt=0.001 ps)

fix npt_quench all npt temp 5000 1500 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Run quenching simulation
run 1000000

# Write final configuration
write_data final_structure.dat

print "Final density: $(density)"
print "Simulation complete"

                if len(parts) >= 5 and parts[0].isdigit():

                        temp = float(parts[1])  # Temperature is column 2
                        density = float(parts[4])  # Density is column 5
                        temperatures.append(temp)
                        densities.append(density)
                    except (ValueError, IndexError):
                        continue

    """Find glass transition temperature using derivative analysis."""
    
    # Sort by temperature (should be decreasing during quenching)
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(temperatures)[::-1]  # Sort descending

    dens_sorted = densities[sorted_indices]

    unique_temps = []
    unique_dens = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(temps_sorted):

            j += 1
        unique_temps.append(temp)
        unique_dens.append(np.mean(dens_list))
        i = j

    dens_sorted = np.array(unique_dens)
